verses.text: Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you; yes, and no one would despise me.
lines: who nursed from the breasts of my mother!
If I found you outside, I would kiss you;
yes, and no one would despise me.

verses.text: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.
lines: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother,
who would instruct me.
I would have you drink spiced wine,
of the juice of my pomegranate.

verses.text: His left hand would be under my head. His right hand would embrace me.
lines: His left hand would be under my head.
His right hand would embrace me.

verses.text: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
lines: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem,
that you not stir up, nor awaken love,
until it so desires.

verses.text: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Under the apple tree I aroused you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.
lines: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness,
leaning on her beloved?
Under the apple tree I aroused you.
There your mother conceived you.
There she was in labor and bore you.

verses.text: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of Yahweh.
lines: Set me as a seal on your heart,
as a seal on your arm;
for love is strong as death.
Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol.
Its flashes are flashes of fire,
a very flame of Yahweh.

verses.text: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.
lines: Many waters can’t quench love,
neither can floods drown it.
If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love,
he would be utterly scorned.

verses.text: We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?
lines: We have a little sister.
She has no breasts.
What shall we do for our sister
in the day when she is to be spoken for?

verses.text: If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar.
lines: If she is a wall,
we will build on her a turret of silver.
If she is a door,
we will enclose her with boards of cedar.

verses.text: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.
lines: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers,
then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.

verses.text: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.
lines: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon.
He leased out the vineyard to keepers.
Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.

verses.text: My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.
lines: My own vineyard is before me.
The thousand are for you, Solomon,
two hundred for those who tend its fruit.

verses.text: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice!
lines: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance,
let me hear your voice!

verses.text: Come away, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices!
lines: Come away, my beloved!
Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices!
